newsitem.title: POLAND: Polifarb-C applies to clear merger issues.
newsitem.headline: Polifarb-C applies to clear merger issues.

text.p: Polish paintmaker Polifarb Cieszyn SA applied to the Polish Securities Commission (KPW) to clear its two share issues for the planned merger with Polifarb Wroclaw, Cieszyn said in a statement on Friday.
Cieszyn has said it plans a bonus issue for its current shareholders of 6,375,000 shares and an issue of 22,103,820 shares for Wroclaw shareholders to be exchanged one-for-one to effect the merger.
Cieszyn currently has 19,125,000 shares, 2,978,820 fewer than Wroclaw. @
Wroclaw shareholders approved the merger earlier this week but did not vote on Cieszyn's version, which would give Cieszyn shareholders 53.5 percent of the new firm.
Wroclaw officials have said a mutual shareholder, BIG, might dispute Cieszyn's version in court but that the merger was still likely to go through as a delay would cost both firms.
On Thursday a Wroclaw shareholder said it and other Western investment funds had asked the KPW to prevent Cieszyn's version of the merger. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
